question: What is the strangest way you have ever paid your bills?
story: My roommate paid rent for eight months with money he kept finding inside our couch. We bought that couch off a curb in September because we had ninety dollars between us and no furniture. It smelled like cough drops. Two weeks in, he lost the remote in the cushions and came back holding a rolled up stack of twenties. Four hundred dollars. We celebrated, ordered wings, and forgot about it. Then it happened again. And again. Every single month, always a different cushion, always right before rent was due. We started calling it the money couch. We stopped inviting people over because we did not want anyone sitting on our income. Here is the twist. It was not the couch. It was his mom. She had been coming by to do our dishes and hiding cash in there, because she knew he would never take it from her hand. He found out at Thanksgiving. He cried into the mashed potatoes.
